question.text: How many days prior to the launch of a scheme must the Private Placement Memorandum (PPM) be filed with SEBI?

explanation.text: The Logic: The PPM shall be filed with SEBI at least 30 days prior to the launch of the scheme. The Trap: 15 days, 21 days, and 45 days are plausible but incorrect periods — none matches the AIF PPM filing window of at least 30 days prior to launch. Note: The PPM has two parts: Part A for minimum disclosures and Part B for additional information specific to the scheme.
